## Pages in this subsection

- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage](index.html.md): This module implements models for various forms of record linkage.

- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.eia_ferc1_inputs](eia_ferc1_inputs/index.html.md): Prepare the inputs to the FERC1 to EIA record linkage model.

- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.eia_ferc1_record_linkage](eia_ferc1_record_linkage/index.html.md): Connect FERC1 plant tables to EIA’s plant-parts with record linkage.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.eia_ferc1_train](eia_ferc1_train/index.html.md): Create spreadsheets for manually mapping FERC-EIA records and validate matches.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.embed_dataframe](embed_dataframe/index.html.md): Tools for embedding a DataFrame to create feature matrix for models.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.link_cross_year](link_cross_year/index.html.md): Define a record linkage model interface and implement common functionality.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.name_cleaner](name_cleaner/index.html.md): This module contains the implementation of CompanyNameCleaner class from OS-Climate’s financial-enti...
